title: Involutions in the Cayley-Dickson construction
summary: We determine all involutions in the Cayley-Dickson construction that extend the involution of the original $*$-algebra. We also find all algebra isomorphisms between the resulting Cayley doubles that extend the identity automorphism of the original $*$-algebra, and consequently classify the resulting $*$-algebras up to $*$-algebra isomorphism.
